Recently Added.title: The Midnight Library
Recently Added.author: Matt Haig
Recently Added.description: Between life and death there is a library, and within that library, the shelves go on forever. Every book provides a chance to try another life you could have lived.

Recently Added.title: Dune
Recently Added.author: Frank Herbert
Recently Added.description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of the boy Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family tasked with ruling an inhospitable world.

Classic Fiction.author: George Orwell
Classic Fiction.description: A dystopian social science fiction novel and cautionary tale. The story follows the life of Winston Smith, a low-ranking member of 'the Party'.

Classic Fiction.title: Pride and Prejudice
Classic Fiction.author: Jane Austen
Classic Fiction.description: A romantic novel of manners that charts the emotional development of the protagonist Elizabeth Bennet.

Classic Fiction.title: Frankenstein
Classic Fiction.author: Mary Shelley
Classic Fiction.description: The story of Victor Frankenstein, a young scientist who creates a sapient creature in an unorthodox scientific experiment.

Fantasy & Sci-Fi.title: The Lord of the Rings Collection
Fantasy & Sci-Fi.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
Fantasy & Sci-Fi.description: The classic fantasy trilogy following the quest to destroy the One Ring.

Fantasy & Sci-Fi.title: The Hobbit
Fantasy & Sci-Fi.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
Fantasy & Sci-Fi.description: A great modern classic and the prelude to The Lord of the Rings. Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit who enjoys a comfortable, unambitious life.

Educational & Philosophy.title: Euclid's Elements
Educational & Philosophy.author: Euclid
Educational & Philosophy.description: The classic treatise on geometry. For over two millennia, this was the primary textbook for teaching mathematics.

Educational & Philosophy.title: Relativity: The Special and General Theory
Educational & Philosophy.author: Albert Einstein
Educational & Philosophy.description: Einstein's own explanation of his famous theory, written for the general public.

Educational & Philosophy.title: Meditations
Educational & Philosophy.author: Marcus Aurelius
Educational & Philosophy.description: A series of personal writings by Marcus Aurelius, Roman Emperor from 161 to 180 AD, recording his private notes to himself and ideas on Stoic philosophy.

Educational & Philosophy.title: The Art of War
Educational & Philosophy.author: Sun Tzu
Educational & Philosophy.description: An ancient Chinese military treatise dating from the Late Spring and Autumn Period. The work, which is attributed to the ancient Chinese military strategist Sun Tzu, is composed of 13 chapters.
